title: U.S. Territories: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: A Last Week Tonight segment on how century-old Supreme Court decisions left U.S. territories such as Puerto Rico, Guam and American Samoa without meaningful representation. It mixes comedy with a history of their legal status.
why: HN people use it as a quick, entertaining primer on territory status, citizenship versus nationality, and voting rights.

quote.text: John Oliver has a great, 13-min segment on U.S. territories
